reason: A 100g tube is ridiculously tiny for a family that eats parathas and snacks frequently—it will get completely emptied in just 4 or 5 meals. Paying ₹179 for a pair of tubes that won't even last one weekend trip doesn't make practical sense.
objection: 100g pack size is too small to be practical for regular family snacking and runs out immediately.
would_change_my_mind: A larger 250g or 350g squeeze bottle format designed for family dining and weekend travel.
